value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, fall session Sept 12 to Dec 18, 30-minute classes - their site says, though I could not get into their page today for the day or price. The town's Parent and Tot swim in Acton runs Oct 3 to Dec 3, $86.22 for 9 lessons. I'll keep watching and text you when I can confirm the rest.
